# Pass Three — Thirty Final Checks

The Awtsmoos is One beyond the split of two and three;
Yet separate render vessels sing one authored melody.

1. Keep authoring API serializable.
2. Avoid functions inside movie data.
3. Define schema version.
4. Define duration precedence.
5. Validate empty movies.
6. Validate missing scene IDs.
7. Validate duplicate IDs.
8. Clamp invalid times.
9. Permit scene-local coordinate systems.
10. Permit normalized responsive coordinates.
11. Make easing names explicit.
12. Support simultaneous tracks.
13. Support nested groups.
14. Support z/layer order.
15. Support opacity and transform baseline.
16. Support text typing/counting/reveal.
17. Support chart/data-driven primitives.
18. Support speech/caption metadata.
19. Support particle lifecycle.
20. Support camera shot presets.
21. Support manual camera keyframes.
22. Keep 2D fallback for spatial concepts where sensible.
23. Keep 3D labels/overlays readable on mobile.
24. Expose play/pause/scrub/restart.
25. Expose current scene and time.
26. Make touch targets large enough.
27. Avoid horizontal control overflow.
28. Test resize/orientation.
29. Surface runtime errors visibly for debugging.
30. Ensure the showcase itself functions as a regression specimen.
